description:
Animate Pyramid of the Pantheon using Does Machines.
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Pyramid of the Pantheon
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more brick counters on it
